original.description: The crowd at the Gare de l’Est, Paris, 3 August 1914. Catalogued by the Bibliothèque nationale de France as "3-8-14, la mobilisation, la foule à la gare de l’Est : [photographie de presse]".
original.photographer: Agence Rol (press agency; the operator is not named)
original.archive: Bibliothèque nationale de France, Agence Rol collection, reference Rol 41647; digitised on Gallica (btv1b6931095g), via Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"; UsageTerms "Public domain"). Credit line on the record: Bibliothèque nationale de France.

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: colorize only if it is chosen over the 2 August departure — two colorized station scenes in one beat would be one too many.

caption: The crowd at the Gare de l’Est on 3 August 1914, the day Germany declared war on France.
credit: Original photograph: Agence Rol, Paris, 3 August 1914; Bibliothèque nationale de France, Rol 41647, via Gallica and Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. An alternate to the 2 August departure rather than an addition to it.
